data.one_liner: Firebase backend integration for chat applications in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Firebase BaaS implementation for chat applications, returning streams of data for messages, rooms, and users. It is designed to work with Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore, and offers optional integration with a chat UI package.
use_when: You are building a chat application backed by Firebase.
You want an open-source, community-driven chat backend setup for Flutter.
You are working on a small project or Proof of Concept.
avoid_when: You need a backend solution other than Firebase.
You are running large-scale applications with massive amounts of data without careful optimization.
strengths: Returns streams of data for messages, rooms, and users.
Easy to use with Firebase Security Rules.
weaknesses: Might not be optimized for large amounts of data.
Recommended mainly for small or PoC projects.
data.setup_notes: Requires a Firebase project, setting up Firebase options, and configuring Firebase Security Rules.

alternatives.name: supabase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Supabase if you prefer an open-source Firebase alternative with PostgreSQL.
